crops.note: Commercial Airplanes segment icon: a photographic Boeing 737 MAX in blue livery, above the 'Commercial Airplanes' label. The airplane's nose extends right to ~x380; the searchBox spans x95-390 to capture the full nose while staying clear of the '$9.2B' value block, which begins at ~x414 (clean ~30px background gap). Kept as an opaque, background-matched rectangular patch (background removal disabled) because the photo sits on the uniform #f2f2f2 chart background, so the padded corners blend seamlessly when the patch is re-placed at the source coordinates. borderBand is 0 because this is an intentional background-matched patch rather than a transparent die-cut icon; subject detection (threshold 14) still centers the crop on the airplane and centerOffset is validated. Excludes the '$9.2B'/'+13% Y/Y' value block, the segment name, and the Boeing wordmark logo.

Defense, Space & Security segment icon: a photographic Boeing CST-100 Starliner crew capsule, above the 'Defense, Space & Security' label. Kept as an opaque, background-matched rectangular patch (background removal disabled; die-cut removal leaves edge speckle on this photo). padding is 8 (tighter than the 737's 10) to keep the opaque patch from extending onto the 'Defense, Space' name top. The tile is placed a few px above its raw source y in the dataset rasterAnnotations so the patch bottom clears the name; the capsule photo sits on the uniform #f2f2f2 chart background so the padded corners still blend. borderBand is 0 (intentional patch, not a transparent die-cut). Excludes the '$7.6B'/'+21% Y/Y' value block and the segment name text below the capsule.
